_comment: Chapter 5 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F21, Pip again (comic): a "barely worn" Collector uniform. It is pink.

text.zh_TW: 皮普穿著一件收集者的制服跳出來：「客人！收集者制服，九成新，只要十枚金幣！穿上它，沒人認得你！」
text.en: Pip hops out wearing a Collector uniform. "Customer! A Collector uniform, barely worn, only ten gold! Put it on and nobody will know you!"

text.zh_TW: 你穿上制服。凱看了你一眼：「……它是粉紅色的。」皮普：「限量款！」
text.en: You put on the uniform. Kai takes one look at you. "...It's pink." Pip: "Limited edition!"
